test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held On: 30 June, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Three statements are given followed by three conclusions numbered I, II, and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All rackets are lotions.

All lotions are wickets.

Some tables are wickets.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some wickets are rackets.

II. Some tables are lotions.

III. All lotions are rackets.

options.text: Only conclusions I and III follow
Only conclusions I and II follow

solution:
**Given Statements:**

All rackets are lotions.

All lotions are wickets.

Some tables are wickets.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/068c8db55484db77d9c82731cee6230d14dd79dc12359c1914537959a3c50c1f.png] 

**Conclusions:**

I. Some wickets are rackets - **True **(All rackets are wickets, so some wickets are rackets is definite true)

II. Some tables are lotions - False (Because, there is no definite relation given between tables and lotions, so It can be possible, but not definite)

III. All lotions are rackets - False (Because, all racket are lotions implies that some lotions are rackets but all lotions are rackets can be possible only)

Thus, the Only Conclusion I follows

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 4".**
